key_catalyst: Alphabet and Tesla earnings reveal negative free cash flow amid surging AI capex
reasoning: Alphabet and Tesla both reported negative free cash flow and massive AI capex increases, sparking steep intraday sell-offs (Alphabet -7.1%, Tesla -15%) that dragged QQQ sharply lower. These earnings shocks are novel, high-severity events with no signs of absorption, and the crude oil spike adds a sustained macro headwind.
